versions.changelog:
- Updated setup instructions to clarify API key retrieval and billing management via pipispy.com.
- Added a reference to the official dashboard at pipiads.com for real-time data and product UI.
- No changes to code or functionality.

- Added a Setup section with instructions for obtaining and setting the required API key.
- No changes to features or functionality.

Initial release of tiktok-shop-ad-library-analytics:

- Enables advanced research on TikTok ads, shop products, and store analytics using PipiAds API.
- Provides tools to search and analyze TikTok ad creatives, shop products, and stores.
- Allows users to connect ad performance with product and store analytics for deeper insights.
- Supports cost awareness by detailing API credit consumption per action.
- Designed for TikTok-focused ad and shop analytics, not for general ecommerce or Facebook ad research.
